versions.changelog:
- Initial release of geekbi-ozon-review-search-skill for analyzing real Ozon product reviews by goodsId.
- Supports precise review research including ratings, content, pros/cons, specs, media, helpful votes, seller replies, and timestamps.
- Defaults to Russia site unless otherwise specified; can fetch site list for other markets.
- Provides summary with total count, filtered highlights, read count, pagination, rating criteria, and time range (up to first 200 reviews).
- Only uses confirmed goodsId and data actually returned—no guessing or assumptions.
- Follows formal pause/resume process for queries and review analysis guidelines.
